positions.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Working with a ARM-based STM processor to write C code to control the Standard Robot - specifically the turret flywheel motor controls using Pulse Width Modulation. 

Implemented communication between the embedded system and the GPU that controls the computer vision based Auto-Aim for the Standard Robot.
positions.insights: Skills: Serial Communications · Computer Vision · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Problem Solving · Git · Software Development · Debugging

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
Launched project and led team of engineers to create a system that simulates the payload vehicle interface of the OmegA rocket to support current and future missions for years to come.

Successfully delivered preliminary, critical, and operational design review to electrical engineering program managers within a 5 month schedule. 

Introduced innovative approach to automate testing and verification of simulator systems using cutting-edge software and embedded system technology that could be applied to systems across all NG divisions.

positions.title: Technician Assistant
positions.description:
Worked alongside certified master technician to troubleshoot and solve specified issues in Chrysler vehicles 
Specializing in debugging problems in the ECU and other electric components of the vehicle.

honors.title: SpaceCRAFT SXSW Hackathon Challenge Winner
honors.description:
Utilization of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, APIs, VR tools, and Robotics using Python and Cython
 
Used Cognitive Neural Networks for image classification and AI for path finding
